cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I took my captain's badge off when you took yours off. Let's put both badges on this rematch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine fell off. I was fixing the pin, not giving up the captaincy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, securing it. Winning it back would settle which of us should lead the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We captain different teams. Losing a game doesn't make either job vacant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then loser organizes both teams' fixtures next month. Will you play for that?
